pois.name: His Majesty's Theatre
pois.description: Opened in 1906, this is the largest theatre in the Grampian region. Constructed of Kemnay and Tillyfourie granite, the building is renowned for its Neo-Renaissance exterior and well-preserved mixed Baroque/Jacobean interior.

pois.name: Union Terrace Gardens
pois.description: Designed by Alexander Marshall Mackenzie (1848-1933) and James Matthews (1819-1898). The sunken Victorian gardens opened to the public in 1879. Engulfed within the heart of Aberdeen, this park is surrounded on all sides by the city's gothic architecture.
